description: Messy handwritten drawing photographed in poor light with a hand shadow. Crossed-out width correction (650 -> 600). No thickness or glass type is written. Written before running the system.
coordinate_convention: x_mm/y_mm = hole centre from the panel bottom-left corner; null when the drawing does not dimension the position

panels.notes: width first written as 650, crossed out and corrected to 600

expected_flags: thickness_mm is not written on the drawing - system must mark CHECK, not guess
glass_type is not stated - system must mark CHECK, not guess
P2 width 600 is a hand correction over a crossed-out 650 - low confidence is acceptable if flagged
